w03_exklusiv.title: Exclusiv: Airport / Exhibition Centre apartment near Düsseldorf
w03_exklusiv.text: Quiet 2‑room apartment with excellent connection towards Düsseldorf Exhibition Centre and airport.
w03_exklusiv.alt: Exclusiv: Airport / Exhibition Centre apartment near Düsseldorf
w03_exklusiv.longDescription:
The Exklusive Flughafen-Messe Apartment near Düsseldorf offers modern accommodation in Duisburg, featuring a private terrace, free Wi-Fi, and beautiful garden views. Located just 12 km from the historic Einschornsteinsiedlung district, this apartment provides both comfort and convenience with complimentary private parking on site.

The apartment includes one bedroom, a spacious living room, a fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator and coffee machine, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Fresh towels and bed linen are provided for your stay.

Duisburg Central Station is 13 km away, while the Silberpalais business district is also just 13 km from the property. Düsseldorf Airport can be reached within 11 km, making this apartment an ideal choice for travelers visiting the Düsseldorf Exhibition Centre or the surrounding Ruhr area.

w04_exklusiv_2.title: Exclusiv 2: Airport / Exhibition Centre apartment near Düsseldorf
w04_exklusiv_2.text: Quiet 3‑room apartment with terrace and excellent connection towards Düsseldorf Exhibition Centre and airport.
w04_exklusiv_2.alt: Exclusiv 2: Airport / Exhibition Centre apartment near Düsseldorf
w04_exklusiv_2.longDescription:
The Exklusive Flughafen-Messe Apartment near Düsseldorf offers modern accommodation in Duisburg with a private terrace, free Wi-Fi, and scenic garden views. Located just 12 km from the historic Einschornsteinsiedlung district, this stylish property features a peaceful garden and complimentary private parking — ideal for guests visiting the Düsseldorf Exhibition Centre or nearby Ruhr area.

The spacious apartment includes two bedrooms, a comfortable living room, a fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator and coffee machine, and two private bathrooms with a shower and hairdryer. Fresh towels and bed linen are provided for your convenience, ensuring a pleasant and worry-free stay.

Duisburg Central Station is 13 km from the Exklusive Flughafen-Messe Apartment near Düsseldorf, while the Silberpalais business district is also 13 km away. Düsseldorf Airport can be reached within 11 km, making this apartment a perfect choice for both business travelers and holiday guests seeking comfort and great transport connections.

w01_derko_apart.title: DERKO Apart
w01_derko_apart.text: Spacious 3-room apartment with convenient motorway access to the A3/A59 and a direct S-Bahn connection to Düsseldorf.
w01_derko_apart.longDescription:
The DERKO Apart offers stylish accommodation in Duisburg with beautiful garden views, a private terrace, and convenient amenities including free Wi-Fi throughout the property. Located approximately 7.2 km from the historic Einschornsteinsiedlung district and 7.8 km from Duisburg Central Station, this apartment combines comfort with excellent transport connections.

The modern holiday apartment features three bedrooms, one bathroom with a shower and hairdryer, and a fully equipped kitchen with all essentials. Fresh towels and bed linen are provided to ensure a relaxing and worry-free stay.

The Silberpalais business district is 7.9 km away, and the Citibank Tower is just 8.1 km from DERKO Apart. Düsseldorf Airport can be reached within 10 km, making this apartment an ideal choice for both business and leisure travelers.

w02_derko_apart_2.title: DERKO Apart 2
w02_derko_apart_2.text: Spacious four-room apartment with 110 m² of living space, offering convenient motorway access to the A3/A59 and a direct S-Bahn connection to Düsseldorf.
w02_derko_apart_2.longDescription:
Located less than 7.2 km from the historic Einschornsteinsiedlung and 7.8 km from Duisburg Central Station, DERKO Apart 2 offers free Wi-Fi and a private terrace. The apartment is 8.2 km from Mercator Hall and 8.5 km from Duisburg Town Hall.

This spacious holiday apartment features four bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator, and two bathrooms with a shower and hairdryer. Fresh towels and bed linen are provided for your stay.

The Silberpalais business district is 7.9 km away, while the Citibank Tower is just 8.1 km from DERKO Apart 2. Düsseldorf Airport can be reached within 10 km, making this apartment a convenient choice for both business and leisure travelers.

w05_dus_1.title: Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport & Exhibition Centre
w05_dus_1.text: 2‑room apartment between Düsseldorf Airport and Exhibition Centre in a well connected location.
w05_dus_1.alt: Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport & Exhibition Centre
w05_dus_1.longDescription:
Located in the Großenbaum district of Duisburg, the Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Trade Fair offers a garden, terrace, and free Wi-Fi throughout the property. The apartment is situated 7.2 km from the historic Einschornsteinsiedlung, 7.7 km from Duisburg Central Station, and 7.9 km from the Silberpalais business district.

This modern holiday apartment features two bedrooms, a living room with a flat-screen TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator and dishwasher, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Fresh towels and bed linen are provided for your convenience.

The Citibank Tower is 8.1 km from the Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Trade Fair, while Mercator Hall is 8.2 km away. Düsseldorf Airport can be reached within 10 km, making this apartment an ideal choice for travelers attending trade fairs or visiting the Ruhr area.

w06_dus_2.title: Central Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Exhibition Centre
w06_dus_2.text: 1‑room apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Exhibition Centre
w06_dus_2.alt: Central Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Exhibition Centre
w06_dus_2.longDescription:
Located less than 7.2 km from the historic Einschornsteinsiedlung and 7.7 km from Duisburg Central Station, the Central Location Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Trade Fair offers free Wi-Fi and a peaceful garden. The apartment is 8.2 km from Mercator Hall and 8.5 km from Duisburg Town Hall.

This cozy holiday apartment features a terrace with garden views, one bedroom, a living room with a flat-screen TV, a well-equipped kitchen with a refrigerator and dishwasher, and one bathroom with a shower. Fresh towels and bed linen are provided for your convenience.

The Silberpalais business district is 7.9 km away, while the Citibank Tower is just 8.1 km from the Central Location Apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Trade Fair. Düsseldorf Airport can be reached within 10 km, making this apartment a great choice for both business and leisure travelers.

w07_dus_3.title: Central Apartment with Terrace near Düsseldorf Airport and Exhibition Centre
w07_dus_3.text: 1‑room apartment near Düsseldorf Airport and Exhibition Centre.
w07_dus_3.alt: Central Apartment with Terrace near Düsseldorf Airport and Exhibition Centre
w07_dus_3.longDescription:
Located in the Großenbaum district of Duisburg, the Central Messe Airport DUS Apartment with Terrace offers modern accommodation with free Wi-Fi throughout the property. The apartment is 7.7 km from Duisburg Central Station, 7.9 km from the Silberpalais business district, and 8.1 km from the Citibank Tower, while the historic Einschornsteinsiedlung is just 7.2 km away.

This cozy holiday apartment features one bedroom, one bathroom, fresh bed linen and towels, a flat-screen TV, a fully equipped kitchen, and a terrace with beautiful garden views.

Mercator Hall is 8.2 km from the Central Messe Airport DUS Apartment with Terrace, while Duisburg Town Hall is 8.5 km away. Düsseldorf Airport can be reached within 10 km, making this apartment a convenient choice for both business and leisure travelers.

ueberUns.headline: About us
ueberUns.description:
We are a young, dynamic company based in Duisburg in the heart of the Ruhr region. Our service covers brokerage, management and valuation of real estate. As a professional partner we also support you with all questions around rental properties.

DERKO Real Estate has specialized over recent years in renting worker accommodation and apartments. We continuously work on our portfolio to create more living space and optimal service.
